categories.name: Smart-TV ACR & Ads
categories.note: Blocks smart-TV screenshot/audio tracking (ACR) and on-screen ads for Samsung, LG, and Roku. Highly effective with minimal breakage; some Roku menus may pause a few seconds when an ad server is unreachable.

categories.name: Amazon Device Telemetry
categories.note: Blocks Fire TV ads and Echo background telemetry. Voice commands are still processed on Amazon's servers - this does not stop Alexa audio, only the silent state/usage reporting.

categories.name: IoT Device Telemetry
categories.note: Mutes phone-home telemetry from Xiaomi, Huawei, Vivo, and OPPO/Realme gear. Some cheap cameras may retry aggressively when blocked.

categories.name: Apple Telemetry & Ads
categories.note: Blocks Apple OS analytics and App Store ads. OFF by default: only takes effect if iCloud Private Relay / 'Limit IP Address Tracking' is disabled on the device, and can affect location/Siri features.

categories.name: Windows/Office Telemetry
categories.note: Blocks Windows/Office diagnostic telemetry. OFF by default: verify Office 365 sync and Xbox Live still work for your setup before leaving it on.
